checks.evidence: Independent shasum -a 256 returned b98066570390b384c3471d3cf7fff17d22e176fc23fdf542162cfe53d0b24e96, exactly matching qa-task.json; stat reported 1,206,619 bytes and unzip -t reported no errors. The ZIP was not rebuilt or modified.

Independent unzip listing and unzip -p inspection confirmed root game.js, game.json and project.config.json. project.config.json declares compileType game, projectname 疯狂切割 and appid 928932; game.json declares deviceOrientation portrait and productVersion 1.0.0. The 1,206,619-byte archive is below 20 MB.

The exact ZIP entry list contains no .html/.htm file. Searches of the archived game.js, application.js and src/settings.json found no index.html, location.href, iframe or webview entry path; game.js initializes the adapter/SystemJS/Cocos Application directly.

ZIP src/settings.json declares launch.launchScene db://assets/scenes/main.scene, preloadBundles main and script package project://src/chunks/bundle.js. ZIP assets/main/config.json maps the main scene, while assets/main/import/c9/c9468ad9-5977-4390-b6fc-b02806174123.json contains the GameRoot component type that is registered as GameBootstrap in assets/main/index.js. This is structural package evidence, not runtime proof.

Direct inspection of the exact ZIP's assets/main/index.js confirmed registered TOUCH_END input, launch/flip tap handling, sharp moon-fruit cut, blunt stone reflect, hazard/fall failure, finish settlement.complete with score, terminal tap reset to ready, and visible feedback color/name updates. These compiled branches match source tests but remain structural evidence only.

Independent read-only runs from the platform workspace all exited 0: ../../../../../../node_modules/.bin/tsx --test tests/*.test.ts reported 8 tests, 8 pass, 0 fail; ../../../../../../node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.core.json passed; the same command with --noUnusedLocals --noUnusedParameters passed. No Cocos build or converter was invoked.

BLOCKED: no authenticated TapTap backend scan, QR launch, or iOS/Android physical-device runtime was available. Therefore startup through touch core loop, failure/settlement and replay was not observed naturally on the submitted TapTap package; web-lite and test APIs were intentionally not used as substitutes.

BLOCKED: without real TapTap rendering on a target phone, independent QA could not inspect portrait framing, touch affordances, visible cut/reflect/failure attribution, settlement readability or replay discoverability. Static scene and color/name code cannot establish a perceptual PASS.

issues.message: The frozen package is statically ready for the next TapTap backend upload/scan step, but is not yet backend-approved or device-validated.

At least one iOS or Android physical-device QR run of the exact ZIP covering cold start, normal touch launch/flip, cut/reflect, attributable failure, settlement and terminal-touch replay.
